edges.reason: Constructor assigns the caller address (msg.sender) to the admin storage variable.
_setImplementation is guarded by require(msg.sender == admin), so the caller decides whether the implementation can be replaced.
delegateToImplementation forwards the stored implementation address as the delegatecall target.
delegateAndReturn delegatecalls the implementation address stored in state.
_setImplementation writes the new implementation address into storage.
_setImplementation caches the old implementation before overwriting it.
The implementation_ parameter is assigned to the implementation state variable.
The implementation_ parameter flows into the implementation storage slot.
allowResign controls the conditional resign delegatecall branch inside _setImplementation.
becomeImplementationData is encoded and passed into the delegated _becomeImplementation call.
becomeImplementationData is ABI-encoded and handed to delegateToImplementation.
_setImplementation calls delegateToImplementation for _resignImplementation and _becomeImplementation.
The callee parameter is the target of the delegatecall in delegateTo.
The data parameter is the payload of the delegatecall in delegateTo.
The success flag captures the delegatecall outcome inside delegateTo.
returnData holds the bytes returned by the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
delegateTo invokes callee.delegatecall(data), an external call executing untrusted implementation code with the delegator's storage.
The delegatecall result (success/returnData) is checked and returned by delegateTo.
delegateToImplementation is a thin wrapper that calls delegateTo with the stored implementation.
delegateAndReturn performs implementation.delegatecall(msg.data), forwarding arbitrary caller calldata to the implementation.
The delegatecall returndata is copied out and returned (or reverted) by delegateAndReturn.
delegateToViewImplementation staticcalls delegateToImplementation on itself.
delegateToViewAndReturn staticcalls itself with the raw msg.data and returns the result via assembly.
Both view helpers route calldata through the same self-staticcall delegation path.
The constructor calls delegateTo to delegatecall initialize(...) on the implementation.
The constructor calls _setImplementation to install the implementation without an admin check (it is still executing as the creator).
The constructor indirectly sets the implementation storage slot through _setImplementation.
The constructor overwrites admin with the admin_ argument after initialization.
The implementation_ constructor argument is used for the initial delegatecall.
The underlying_ constructor argument is ABI-encoded into the initialize call.
The fallback forwards all calldata to delegateAndReturn.
